list.name: Changes
list.comment:
chore(ide): update workspace settings
Streamline `.idea/workspace.xml` by refining IDE tasks and settings.

task.summary: Default task

chore(ide): remove unused ide settings
Remove unnecessary IntelliJ IDEA settings to reduce project clutter and improve collaboration. This change helps keep the project repository clean.

refactor(dataProvider): switch to dynamic API or static snapshot
Use live API when VITE_API_URL is set, otherwise fall back to static JSON data. This improves flexibility and allows for easier development and testing. Reduces need for manual data updates.
feat(data): added data

chore(package): update dependencies and package info
Remove unnecessary fields from package.json to improve project configuration. Add ra-data-simple-rest dependency to enhance data handling capabilities. This simplifies the project structure and reduces dependencies.

fix(index.html): update favicon link
Update favicon to use correct SVG file to maintain visual consistency. This improves overall user experience.

chore(config): update project metadata
Remove outdated user ID and add migration status to improve project configuration consistency. This reflects recent changes in user identification.

feat(server): add express server with dotenv and PostgreSQL support
Introduce an Express-based server with added support for environment variables using dotenv and PostgreSQL database integration. Additionally, include a new `dev:full` script for concurrent server and client development.

feat(components): add LastUpdated component
Display last update timestamp to improve user experience and provide transparency about data freshness. This enhances overall dashboard usability and trustworthiness.

feat(dashboard): add last updated component
Improve dashboard by displaying last updated information to users. This enhances transparency and user trust. The component is added above the station cards section.

feat(components): add LastUpdated component
Display last update timestamp and statistics about records and cities. Improve user experience by providing real-time data updates. Enhance dashboard with additional information.

remove(components/LastUpdated): delete unused component
Component is no longer used in the application and its removal simplifies the codebase. This reduces maintenance overhead and improves overall quality.

chore(deployment): configure Vercel deployment settings
Add Vercel configuration to enable seamless deployment of the application. This includes ignoring Vercel files and setting up build and route configurations. This improves the overall deployment process.

chore(build): update vercel configuration
Add includeFiles config to vercel node build to improve build process and reduce errors. This enhances the overall build reliability and performance of the application.

chore(package.json): add vercel-build script
Add new script to improve deployment process to Vercel. This enhances the automated build process for production environment. Improves overall workflow.

feat(build): configure proxy and optimize build output
Add proxy to enable API requests to localhost:4000. Improve build performance by splitting code into chunks. This enhances development experience and reduces bundle size.

feat(server): initialize Express server with database connection
Create an Express server with PostgreSQL database connection and implement API endpoints for air quality data retrieval. This includes measures and cities data with filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities. The server also provides health check and latest timestamp endpoints.

chore(package): add project dependencies
Initialize project with basic dependencies and scripts to improve development workflow and enable API functionality. This sets up the foundation for the aqi-dashboard-api.
chore(server): add package-lock.json with resolved dependencies

chore(ide): initialize IntelliJ IDEA project settings
Add necessary configuration files to enable IntelliJ IDEA project settings and improve development experience. This change helps keep the project repository organized.

docs(server): add API documentation for aqi-dashboard
Explain API endpoints and setup process for server and dashboard connectivity. This improves developer understanding of the API and its usage.

feat(server): add environment variable configuration
Load environment variables from .env file in root directory to improve security and flexibility. This allows for easy switching between development and production environments. Configure CORS allowed origins and server port dynamically.

feat(api): add API endpoints for air quality data
Create API endpoints to retrieve and manage air quality data, including measures and cities. Implement pagination, sorting, and filtering for measures and cities. Add endpoint to retrieve latest timestamp and health check. Improve data retrieval and error handling.

chore(config): remove vercel configuration
Remove Vercel configuration file to disable automatic builds and deployments. This change helps to prevent unwanted deployments and reduces potential security risks. The project will now require manual deployment.

refactor(api): simplify CORS configuration and routes
Remove redundant CORS configuration and simplify routes for better readability and maintainability. This reduces complexity and improves code quality.

chore(config): add engine-strict flag
Enable engine-strict to ensure consistent package installation across different environments and improve project reliability. This enhances overall project stability and reduces potential issues with dependencies.

chore(package.json): update dependencies
Update package.json to include vite and remove redundant oxlint and vite from devDependencies. This improves project configuration and reduces potential conflicts.

chore(deployment): add Vercel configuration
Configure Vercel for application deployment and routing. This enables seamless deployment of the application to the Vercel platform.

refactor(build): simplify vite config
Remove unnecessary rollup options and manual chunks to reduce configuration complexity and improve maintainability of the build process.

refactor(api): simplify CORS configuration and routes
Remove redundant CORS configuration and simplify routes for better readability and maintainability. This reduces complexity and improves code quality.

refactor(api): simplify CORS configuration and routes
Remove redundant CORS configuration and simplify routes for better readability and maintainability. This reduces complexity and improves code quality.

chore(ide): update vercel configuration
Update vercel.json to include new route configurations and remove redundant settings for better maintainability. This improves the overall project structure and reduces configuration complexity.

chore(ide): remove vercel configuration
Remove vercel.json to simplify project configuration and reduce complexity. This change improves project maintainability and removes redundant settings.

refactor(dashboard): remove unnecessary typography component
Remove unused typography component to simplify dashboard layout and improve readability. This reduces visual noise and enhances user experience.

chore(ci): configure vercel deployment settings
Add vercel.json to define builds and routes for the application to enable proper deployment and routing on the vercel platform. This improves the overall deployment process and user experience.

chore(ide): update workspace settings
Streamline `.idea/workspace.xml` by refining IDE tasks and settings.
